metrics.dose_basis: energy index relative to 85 dBA; not an EU legal dose

peak.basis: unprotected C-weighted peak; no scalar protector credit

metrics.limit_basis: unprotected screen; attenuation estimates do not establish EU limit compliance

recommendations: Enrol exposed workers in a hearing conservation programme; arrange audiometry, training and monitoring as applicable.
Engineering controls first: follow the hierarchy of controls, reduce noise at source, isolate equipment and then review exposure time.
Select and individually fit-test hearing protection; verify continuous correct use and repeat the assessment after controls.
EU upper action level reached: implement a technical/organisational noise reduction programme and enforce protector use as applicable.
methodology: Actual dose uses recorded durations and each preset's threshold and exchange rate. TWA and LEX,8h are normalized to 8 hours. Projections repeat the measured exposure mix; they are estimates, not additional observations. EU action levels use unprotected exposure; 87 dBA / 140 dBC limit screening receives no estimated protector credit. Exposure-limit equality is ACTION LEVEL; OVER LIMIT denotes strictly above the limit. See docs/methodology.md for formulas and references.
disclaimer: Not a substitute for a competent person's assessment with calibrated class 1/2 instruments. Estimates depend on representative measurements and correct protector fit. NIOSH/ACGIH are guidance criteria, not OSHA permissible limits.
